name: 87031 · Los Lunas, NM
findings: ZIP 87031 (Los Lunas) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 87031 (Los Lunas) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
56% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
